agr0: In a study using data from 2,724 people with long-term pain, an average drop of 2 points, or about 30%, on the 0–10 scale matched people feeling meaningfully better. This is an average; what matters for you is what changes in your daily life. An international expert group (IMMPACT) also recommends looking at daily functioning, mood and the person’s own overall rating alongside pain intensity when judging improvement.
